sections.content: *Soha* means “never”, and in Hungarian it works together with *nem*. *Soha nem főzök* is “I never cook”, word for word “never not cook”. English uses one negative word; Hungarian uses two, and *nem* stays right before the verb.

sections.title: Short answer and time word
sections.content: As a short answer, *Soha.* alone is enough: *Te főzöl? Soha.* The time word can stay in front: *Reggel soha nem tanulunk.*

items.english: In the morning we never study.

sections.content: Do not drop the *nem*. *Soha főzök* is not a Hungarian sentence. The second negative is not a mistake here, it is part of the rule.
